conventions.plane: overworld plane; layer 0 surface, negative below, positive above
conventions.local_layout: each member map gets a group-local origin (x, y, layer) by BFS over tile links from layout_root (root origin = filename coordinates*size when present, else 0,0,0); N/S/E/W/diagonals offset by neighbour/own width/height exactly as get_map_from_coord(); up/down = layer +1/-1
conventions.placement: plane tile = local origin + tile + (x_offset, y_offset); plane layer = local layer + layer_offset
conventions.footprint: a map occupies only tiles holding at least one object (occupied_rows: '#'); every other legacy tile becomes void
conventions.gap_rule: on one layer, occupied tiles of a placed group and of any owner it shares no exit with (overworld map or other placed group) are more than view_radius_tiles apart (Chebyshev); owners it shares an exit with are more than contact_margin_tiles apart
conventions.stairs: an exit 'becomes stairs' when after placement source and destination differ by exactly one layer and by <= 1 tile(s) horizontally
conventions.stairwell: an exit whose ends are >= 2 layers apart and <= 1 tile(s) apart horizontally becomes a stairwell: one stair tile on every intermediate layer, each consecutive pair one layer and <= 1 tile apart; the whole stairwell is ONE exit (one use moves the player end to end, pathfinding sees one edge)
conventions.sloped_stairwell: an exit whose ends are >= 2 layers apart and more than 1 but at most 1 tile(s) per layer apart horizontally becomes a sloped stairwell (shape 'sloped'): the same chain, shifting at most 1 tile sideways per layer; still ONE exit
conventions.stairwell_rendering: segments_drawn_only_on_player_layer: clients draw a stairwell's segments only on the layer the player is on (owner decision 2026-10-18), so view_conflicts are listed but not seen
conventions.stairwell_direction: direction 'both': exits at both ends, each targeting the other end; 'down' or 'up': the stairwell replaces a legacy one-way exit and can be used only that way; its landing_only_end holds no exit
conventions.stairwell_contacts: contacts: intermediate tiles within contact_margin_tiles of a related area (other than the stairwell's own group); the chain search avoids them where it can
conventions.stairwell_ids: SWn = stairwell built for a placed group's aligned exits, SLn = sloped stairwell, SRn = stairwell for an overworld exit whose ends the relayering put 2+ layers apart
conventions.relayering: overworld tiles are on their final layer everywhere in this plan (see relayering); occupied_rows_by_layer gives each map's tiles per final layer
conventions.wired_exits: an exit with form 'wired' led nowhere in legacy; it now targets the content on the layer above or below (see its 'wired' evidence)
conventions.exits_kept_as_decoration: dangling exits the owner keeps as decoration (no exit): not wired, with the landing they would have had

view_radius_sensitivity.why: radius of the shipped classic client's largest view (wire size 21 = MAP_LOOK_SIZE_MAX 17 + 2 * MAP_RENDER_OVERSCAN); the plan uses the server bound 16 instead
